maddeler.e:
آتلق (form VIII)
# آتَلِقُ (ʔātaliqu) /ʔaː.ta.li.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# آتَلِقَ (ʔātaliqa) /ʔaː.ta.li.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# آتَلِقْ (ʔātaliq) /ʔaː.ta.liq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
